newsitem.title: CHINA: China produces 34.34 mln T of steel in Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: China produces 34.34 mln T of steel in Jan-April.

text.p: China produced 34.34 million tonnes of steel in January to April, a jump of 6.4 percent compared with the year-ago period, the China Daily said on Friday.

Output of pig iron reached 37.51 tonnes, up by 3.6 percent while production of rolled steel rose 9.6 percent to 30.20 million tonnes, it said quoting an official of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry.
Average daily output of steel rose to 286,900 tonnes in April from 260,900 tonnes in January and 285,600 tonnes in February, it said.

"If we maintain the average daily output level of the first quarter, the annual output of steel will surpass 100 million tonnes," the newspaper quoted the official as saying. China first exceeded output of 100 million tonnes last year.
China aims to cut two million tones of imports by boosting domestic output of quality steel this year, officials have said.

China imported 4.12 million tonnes of rolled steel in the first four months, down by 12.58 percent from a year ago, the newspaper said. Exports of rolled steel reached 1.35 million tonnes, up 22.73 percent, it said.
